meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 运行后,Claude Code 等编码工具会把旧版 NanoClaw 与 Claude 原生记忆(.seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等)搬进共享记忆树 memory/,整理成概念文件并写入标准指令文件。
howto.when: 更新提示共享记忆破坏性变更后,或某个 group 仍留有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、Claude auto-memory 等文件时;说出“migrate memory”等词也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 group 的遗留记忆迁移到共享记忆树
say.note: 会先列出受影响 group,请你确认后才移动

say.text: 帮我检查还有哪些 group 留着 .seed.md 或旧 CLAUDE.md
say.note: 先做清点,不读取文件内容

say.text: 迁移后回滚,把改动撤回到迁移前
say.note: 按记录的源到目标清单反向恢复

howto.what_en: When run, the coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree memory/, organizes it into concept files and standing instructions, and reports source-to-destination.
howto.when_en: Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, Claude auto-memory, etc. Also triggered by "migrate memory".

say_en.text: Migrate this group's legacy memory into the shared memory tree
say_en.note: Lists affected groups and asks for approval first

say_en.text: Check which groups still have .seed.md or legacy CLAUDE.md
say_en.note: Inventories paths without reading file contents

say_en.text: Roll back the migration to the pre-migration state
